# IMPOSSIBLE: Set the air conditioner to swing up in the living room (no air conditioner found)

class AdjustDehumidifierIntensity(py_trees.behaviour.Behaviour):
    def __init__(self, name, property_url, action_url, adjustment):
        super().__init__(name)
        self.property_url = property_url
        self.action_url = action_url
        self.adjustment = adjustment

    def update(self):
        try:
            response = http_client.get(self.property_url)
            if response.status_code == 200:
                current_intensity = response.json()
                new_intensity = max(0, min(100, current_intensity + self.adjustment))
                response = http_client.post(self.action_url, json={"intensity": new_intensity})
                return Status.SUCCESS if response.status_code == 200 else Status.FAILURE
            return Status.FAILURE
        except Exception:
            return Status.FAILURE

class AdjustCurtainDegree(py_trees.behaviour.Behaviour):
    def __init__(self, name, property_url, action_url, adjustment):
        super().__init__(name)
        self.property_url = property_url
        self.action_url = action_url
        self.adjustment = adjustment

    def update(self):
        try:
            response = http_client.get(self.property_url)
            if response.status_code == 200:
                current_degree = response.json()
                new_degree = max(0, min(100, current_degree + self.adjustment))
                response = http_client.post(self.action_url, json={"degree": new_degree})
                return Status.SUCCESS if response.status_code == 200 else Status.FAILURE
            return Status.FAILURE
        except Exception:
            return Status.FAILURE

class SetLightBrightness(py_trees.behaviour.Behaviour):
    def __init__(self, name, action_url, brightness):
        super().__init__(name)
        self.action_url = action_url
        self.brightness = brightness

    def update(self):
        try:
            response = http_client.post(self.action_url, json={"brightness": self.brightness})
            return Status.SUCCESS if response.status_code == 200 else Status.FAILURE
        except Exception:
            return Status.FAILURE

class SetACTemperature(py_trees.behaviour.Behaviour):
    def __init__(self, name, action_url, temperature):
        super().__init__(name)
        self.action_url = action_url
        self.temperature = temperature

    def update(self):
        try:
            response = http_client.post(self.action_url, json={"temperature": self.temperature})
            return Status.SUCCESS if response.status_code == 200 else Status.FAILURE
        except Exception:
            return Status.FAILURE

living_room_dehumidifier = AdjustDehumidifierIntensity(
    name="Decrease Living Room Dehumidifier Intensity",

    action_url="http://localhost:8080/workspaces/home96/living_room/artifacts/livingRoomDehumidifiers/set_intensity",

# Balcony Curtain: Increase degree by 50%

    property_url="http://localhost:8080/workspaces/home96/balcony/artifacts/balconyCurtain/properties/degree",
    action_url="http://localhost:8080/workspaces/home96/balcony/artifacts/balconyCurtain/set_degree",
    adjustment=50

# Garage Light: Set brightness to 10
garage_light = SetLightBrightness(
    name="Set Garage Light Brightness",
    action_url="http://localhost:8080/workspaces/home96/garage/artifacts/garageLight/set_brightness",
    brightness=10
)

# Guest Bedroom Air Conditioner: Set temperature to 16
guest_bedroom_ac = SetACTemperature(
    name="Set Guest Bedroom AC Temperature",
    action_url="http://localhost:8080/workspaces/home96/guest_bedroom/artifacts/guestBedroomAirConditioner/set_temperature",
    temperature=16

# Study Room Dehumidifier: Increase intensity by 50%

# Create the behavior tree
root = py_trees.composites.Parallel(
    name="Root",
    policy=py_trees.common.ParallelPolicy.SuccessOnAll(),
    children=[
        living_room_dehumidifier,
        balcony_curtain,
        garage_light,
        guest_bedroom_ac,
        study_room_dehumidifier
